card.name: Digit 1 inside parenthetical numbers
card.fires_on: The digit 1 (or the digit after it) at the start of a number inside parentheses, mostly a converted measure like (16 mi) or a percentage like (12.9%).

modes.label: Converted distances
modes.description: Digit 1 starting the converted mile figure after a kilometre value in parentheses.

modes.label: Parenthetical dose or count
modes.description: Leading 1 in a parenthetical amount or patient percentage.
modes.example: 2 mL (<<1>>00 mg of iron) for other

modes.label: Second digit of conversion
modes.description: The digit after the leading 1 in a parenthetical mile figure.

card.plain: It marks the digit 1 at the start of a number inside brackets, such as a unit conversion or a percentage.
